strided-load.interpretation: Counts are grouped by source-correlated SASS addresses. Compare actual to ideal; multiple ideal wavefronts for wide LDS are not conflicts. Hardware bank-conflict counters can additionally include arbitration effects. inst_executed and opcode instruction counts include predicated-off executions; do not divide wavefront totals by those counts to infer conflict degree.
